children: StageWise Strategies entered into a Share Exchange Agreement to acquire 99.99999012% of TEG SPV in a stock-for-equity transaction. The company will issue 183,098,434 common shares to the sellers, leaving them with approximately 97.3% of the 188,142,768 shares expected outstanding post-close. Closing is subject to customary conditions, Uzbek registration, and a concurrent financing of at least $18 million. Following completion, TEG SPV will become a subsidiary and its business will become StageWise Strategies' primary operation.
